info.name: SIDIS – Entrega 2 (Modo A)
info.description:
AISafe Entrega 2, Mode A (IntelliJ): Airports & Routes (8091-8093) and Flight Operations (8081-8083), plus Aircraft (8071-8073) for the aircraft lookups + local Keycloak and NGINX gateway (8443) for login, as in the Entrega 1 Mode A collection.
Extra requirement: RabbitMQ on localhost:5672: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.services.yml up -d rabbitmq (user aisafe / password aisafe-mq). In the 3 'Airports - Instância N' Run Configurations add SPRING_RABBITMQ_USERNAME=aisafe and SPRING_RABBITMQ_PASSWORD=aisafe-mq.
Flight Operations: one PostgreSQL per instance on localhost:5441/5442/5443 (db/user/password flightops); in each 'FlightOperationsApplication - Instance N' Run Configuration set DB_URL=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:544N/flightops.
Use with the SIDIS environment (ar1, ar2, ar3, gateway, realm, clientId, pwd*). Turn off SSL verification.
Reads between instances carry X-P2P-Hops: 1 (no forwarding), so a 200 proves the event arrived through RabbitMQ.
Folders 00 to 07: automatic. Folders 08 and 09: manual (~1 min each).

item.name: 00.00 Keycloak realm is reachable – starts a new run {NONE} → 200

exec: pm.test('Realm info matches the configured realm', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().realm).to.eql(pm.environment.get('realm')));
pm.test('JWKS exposes an RS256 signing key', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().keys.some(k => k.alg === 'RS256')).to.be.true);
pm.test('Status code is 400 or 401 (Keycloak answers invalid_grant)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([400, 401]));

exec: pm.test('Exchange is fanout and durable', () => { pm.expect(j.type).to.eql('fanout'); pm.expect(j.durable).to.be.true; });

item.name: 01 Commands and AMQP events across 3 instances
01.02 The airport reaches instances 2 and 3 through RabbitMQ (no P2P forwarding) {BACKOFFICE} → 200

exec: // Poll one instance until `n` consecutive answers satisfy `pred`. X-P2P-Hops: 1 turns forwarding off, so a good
// answer means the event really reached THAT instance through RabbitMQ.
const until = async (inst, role, path, pred, o = {}) => {
const n = o.n || 2, end = Date.now() + (o.ms || 30000); let ok = 0, last;
last = await L.call('GET', path, null, role, pm.environment.get(inst), HOP);
let good = false; try { good = !!pred(last); } catch (e) {}
const r = await until(n, 'BACKOFFICE', '/api/airports/' + pm.environment.get('e2Iata'), x => x.code === 200);
pm.test(n + ' has the airport (event applied)', () => pm.expect(r.ok, 'last status ' + r.last.code).to.be.true);

const name = pm.info.requestName, env = k => pm.environment.get(k);
const base = Date.UTC(2031 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8), Math.floor(Math.random() * 12), 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 25));
const K = {ADMIN: 'Admin', ATCC: 'Atcc', BACKOFFICE: 'Backoffice', TECH: 'Tech', SUPERVISOR: 'Supervisor'}[role];
const U = {ADMIN: 'admin.user', ATCC: 'atcc.user', BACKOFFICE: 'backoffice.user', TECH: 'tech.user', SUPERVISOR: 'supervisor.user'}[role];
const setH = t => pm.request.headers.upsert({key: 'Authorization', value: 'Bearer ' + t});
if (env('token' + K) && Number(env('exp' + K) || 0) > Date.now() + 15000) { setH(env('token' + K)); return; }

const login = (b, cb) => pm.sendRequest({url: b + '/realms/' + env('realm') + '/protocol/openid-connect/token', method: 'POST', header: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}, body: {mode: 'urlencoded', urlencoded: [{key: 'grant_type', value: 'password'}, {key: 'client_id', value: env('clientId')}, {key: 'username', value: U}, {key: 'password', value: env('pwd' + K)}]}}, cb);

const ok = (e, r) => { if (e || r.code !== 200) return false; const j = r.json(); pm.environment.set('token' + K, j.access_token); pm.environment.set('exp' + K, String(Date.now() + j.expires_in * 1000)); setH(j.access_token); return true; };
login(env('gateway'), (e, r) => { if (!ok(e, r)) login(env('gateway2'), (e2, r2) => { if (!ok(e2, r2)) console.error('Login failed for role ' + role); }); });
pm.test('Response body does not leak a stack trace', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/\.java:\d+/));

variable.value: (() => { const env = k => pm.environment.get(k); const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const send = o => new Promise(r => pm.sendRequest(o, (e, res) => r(res || {code: 0, headers: {get: () => null, has: () => false}, text: () => String(e), json: () => ({})}))); const U = {ADMIN: ['admin.user', 'pwdAdmin'], ATCC: ['atcc.user', 'pwdAtcc'], BACKOFFICE: ['backoffice.user', 'pwdBackoffice'], TECH: ['tech.user', 'pwdTech'], SUPERVISOR: ['supervisor.user', 'pwdSupervisor']}; const cache = {}; const tok = async (role, gw) => { const g = gw || env('gateway'); const k = role + g; if (cache[k]) return cache[k]; const r = await send({url: g + '/realms/' + env('realm') + '/protocol/openid-connect/token', method: 'POST', header: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}, body: {mode: 'urlencoded', urlencoded: [{key: 'grant_type', value: 'password'}, {key: 'client_id', value: env('clientId')}, {key: 'username', value: U[role][0]}, {key: 'password', value: env(U[role][1])}]}}); cache[k] = r.json().access_token; return cache[k]; }; const call = async (m, p, b, role, base, extra) => { const h = Object.assign({'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, extra || {}); if (role && role !== 'NONE') h.Authorization = 'Bearer ' + await tok(role); let r; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { r = await send({url: (base || env('gateway')) + p, method: m, header: h, body: b ? {mode: 'raw', raw: typeof b === 'string' ? b : JSON.stringify(b)} : undefined}); if (r.code !== 429) break; await sleep(1200); } await sleep(110); return r; }; const b64u = s => { const C = require('crypto-js'); return C.enc.Base64.stringify(C.enc.Utf8.parse(s)).replace(/=+$/, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_'); }; const hs = (secret, claims) => { const C = require('crypto-js'); const h = b64u(JSON.stringify({alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT'})); const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000); const p = b64u(JSON.stringify(Object.assign({iat: now, exp: now + 3600}, claims))); const s = C.enc.Base64.stringify(C.HmacSHA256(h + '.' + p, secret)).replace(/=+$/, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_'); return h + '.' + p + '.' + s; }; return {env, sleep, send, tok, call, hs, b64u, U}; })()
